Iron Mountain is seeking a commercially and operationally driven Grid Interconnection & Power Delivery Manager to join our Global Data Centers team.

In this role, your primary objective is to secure access to power for our expanding data center portfolio. As the commercial and process orchestrator for our grid connections, you will focus on negotiating grid access agreements with transmission or distribution system operators, translating utility contracts into clear businessimpacts, and driving the end-to-end timeline to ensure internal teams and project managers execute perfectly.

What You'll Do (Responsibilities)

- Determine the Pathway to Power for new sites: Know the system connection process for target markets, the responsible parties and the technical criteria for meeting new site needs. This includes a general understanding of system upgrade processes, power redundancy practices, system voltages and components necessary to deliver power.

- Commercial Negotiation & Translation: Lead the negotiation of grid connection agreements (ESAs) with local utilities. You will translate these complex utility contracts and grid constraints into clear operational and commercial realities for IMDC projects and our end customers. This includes validating the technical aspects of power design and delivery to the site, including upstream system resources.

- Process Orchestration: Own the master timeline for power delivery. You will coordinate "who does what and when," ensuring that local Project Managers for new and existing data center locations hit critical verification, submission, and operational milestones at exactly the right moment.

- Contract Lifecycle Management: Deeply understand the ongoing requirements of our grid access contracts. You will manage the lifetime of the contract, ensuring we meet utilization thresholds, mitigate commercial risk, and maintain compliance long after the initial agreement is signed.

- Cross-Functional & 3rd Party Leadership: Act as the central node between our external technical consultants, utilities, sales teams, and construction teams. You will ensure technical data is seamlessly handed off and applied to the commercial strategy.

- Risk & Timeline Alignment: Actively monitor utility requirements against reality. You will track critical thresholds (such as underutilization clauses or customer ramp-up timelines) to ensure our capacity commitments align with actual customer deployment.

What You'll Bring (Skills & Qualifications)

- Technical Understanding: Knowledge of electrical system components and voltages sufficient to ensure contracts deliver power aligned to the needs of our new facilities.

- Commercial & Operational Rigor: You are a meticulous process manager and a strongcommercial negotiator. You know how to hold cross-functional teams and external utilities accountable to strict timelines.

- Cross-Functional Teamwork: You are highly comfortable and effective at working across different teams. You build solid relationships naturally and can bridge the communication gaps between technical engineers, commercial sales teams, and external utility partners

- Industry & Utility Expertise: Demonstrable experience in energy procurement, utility relations, or infrastructure project management for energy-intensive consumers. You must have a track record of negotiating directly with utilities or system operators.

- Contractual Fluency: You must be able to read a complex grid connection contract and immediately understand what it means for the project's construction timeline and the customer's ramp-up schedule.

- Location: Must be based in the US.

- Education: Bachelor's degree in business, electrical engineering, project management, or an energy-related discipline.

What We Offer (Benefits)

- Competitive compensation and benefits aligned with the experience.

- Flexible work options to support work-life balance.

- Comprehensive health, wellness, and retirement plans.

- Opportunities for continuous learning and professional growth.

Ready to power the future of digital infrastructure? Apply today to join Iron Mountain and help build what's next.

Iron Mountain is seeking a commercially-driven and detail-oriented Senior Deal Modeler & Pricing Analyst to join our Digital Business Unit (DBU) Americas team.

In this role, you’ll play a key part in translating technical architecture into competitive pricing structures that drive our digital transformation efforts forward. You will have the opportunity to independently build financial models and margin analyses , ensuring our custom digital solutions are priced efficiently and sustainably. Here, your expertise will help evaluate complex deal economics and shape the strategic direction of our rapidly growing digital service offerings.

What You’ll Do
In this role, you will:

- Build Deal-Level Pricing Models: Translate technical solution inputs and operational estimates into accurate financial models and line-item margin analyses.

- Prepare Executive Presentations: Craft clear pricing summaries, sensitivity charts, and presentation decks to outline deal economics and recommend structures for leadership review.

- Perform Scenario Modeling: Conduct financial sensitivity analyses, break-even calculations, and triage incoming deal requests against intake criteria.

- Apply Cost Benchmarks: Utilize established Cost Master metrics for labor, equipment, and facility overhead to ensure custom deal builds and Change Requests are priced effectively.

- Analyze Performance Metrics: Monitor discounting trends, concession logs, and operational throughput to identify systemic opportunities for margin and price growth.

What You’ll Bring
The ideal candidate will have:

- 5+ years of experience in Strategic Pricing, or Deal Desk within digital services, B2B, tech and complex multinational matrix environments.

- Strong knowledge of SaaS business environments and ​advanced Sheets financial modeling and evaluating complex technical solution scopes or capital investments.

- Proven ability to translate intricate data into clear, actionable insights using professional presentation tools (e.g., G Suite / Slides) for non-finance stakeholders.

- Demonstrated capability to independently lead deal modeling for multi-variable opportunities with minimal supervisory oversight.

- A Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or Economics and fluent in English and Spanish. Portuguese is a plus. (please submit your cv in English).

What We Offer

- Working from Home Model

- Competitive compensation and benefits aligned with experience.

- Opportunities for continuous learning and professional growth in a global environment.

THE OPPORTUNITY
Title: Senior Manager, Global Market Strategy, Data Centers

Iron Mountain is seeking a strategic, analytical, and motivated professional to join our Iron Mountain Data Centers (IMDC) team as Senior Manager, Global Market Strategy, Data Centers.

In this newly created role, you will be responsible for bringing data-driven market insights and rigorous commercial intelligence to our global data center strategy, establishing a centralized intelligence function that directly influences capital allocation, site selection, and commercial underwriting and you will present market strategies and investment recommendations to the IMDC Executive Team.

You will join a dynamic, collaborative global team that serves as a critical strategic bridge between investment, development, and sales across all operating geographies.

What You’ll Do
In this role, you will:

- Strategic Market Positioning: Evaluate global macroeconomic trends, cloud Availability Zone architectures, and power grid constraints to identify and prioritize next-generation data center markets.

- Geospatial & Ecosystem Mapping: Build and own the visual data architecture using Geographic Information System mapping assets to define targeted land search areas and validate site selection.

- Commercial Intelligence & Underwriting: Partner with Investment and Finance teams to inject real-time market data into financial models, maintaining a proprietary database of global transaction pricing and competitor pipelines by Ready for Service dates.

- Cross-Functional Advisory: Synthesize complex supply, demand, and pricing dynamics into high-impact briefings for executive leadership and the Investment Committee to derisk capital deployment.

- Global Framework Design: Establish a standardized, repeatable market intelligence framework and consistent taxonomy to compare global investment opportunities on an apples-to-apples basis.

What You’ll Bring
The ideal candidate will have:

- Extensive experience in market intelligence, corporate strategy, commercial real estate underwriting, or data center development.

- Strong knowledge of global data center infrastructure dynamics, cloud provider architectures, and power grid operating constraints.

- Proven ability in translating complex market data and competitive benchmarking into actionable financial models and commercial terms.

- Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with a demonstrated ability to act as a trusted advisor to regional leadership and executive C-suite committees.

What We Offer

- Competitive compensation and benefits aligned with senior-level experience.

- Flexible work options and alternative work arrangements to support work–life balance.

- Comprehensive health, wellness, and retirement plans.

- Opportunities for continuous learning and professional growth within a transforming, global organization.

- A supportive, inclusive environment where you have a safe space to voice your opinion, share feedback, and build global connectivity with over 27,000 teammates across 63 countries.

If you are ready to bring your expertise and creativity to a workplace that thrives on continuous improvement and innovation, we want to hear from you. Apply today!
